           CAST(strftime('%j', CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as day_of_year
    FROM cities

    FROM day_data
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, day_of_year, prev_day,
           day_of_year - prev_day as gap
    FROM with_prev
    WHERE prev_day IS NOT NULL
),
with_streak AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, day_of_year, gap,
           SUM(CASE WHEN gap != 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY day_of_year) as streak_id
    FROM with_diff
    WHERE prev_day IS NOT NULL
),
streak_counts AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, streak_id, COUNT(*) as streak_length
    FROM with_streak
    GROUP BY country_code_2, streak_id
),
max_streak_per_country AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, MAX(streak_length) as max_streak
    FROM streak_counts
    GROUP BY country_code_2

SELECT country_code_2
FROM max_streak_per_country
WHERE max_streak = (SELECT MAX(max_streak) FROM max_streak_per_country)
